rationale: Quinbrook and Rowan identify Rowan Digital Infrastructure as the manager-level company and Bauxite I-III as one subordinate Maryland campus. Government evidence confirms Rowan owns the three Bauxite parcels. The standalone Bauxite record should merge into Rowan, but UPP's current platform-level ownership after the April 2026 Blackstone recap remains unresolved and blocks application under the active-ownership rule.
recommendedChanges: Merge/remove the standalone Rowan Bauxite PortCo record into Rowan Digital Infrastructure.
Preserve Bauxite I, II and III as subordinate campus assets and milestones.
Preserve the Maryland location, approximately 625-630 MW campus scale, phase delivery status and disclosed construction-financing milestones.
Exclude Amazon, Quantum/Catellus, Potomac Edison, lenders and contractors from equity ownership.
Resolve UPP's post-recapitalization Rowan position before applying the merge or changing Rowan ownership.
unresolvedQuestions: UPP's ownership status after the April 9, 2026 Blackstone recapitalization is unresolved.
The exact Quinbrook, UPP and Blackstone percentages and governance rights are not publicly disclosed.
The exact Rowan Frederick SPV chain and parcel acquisition dates need direct deed-level confirmation.
fieldCorrections: Do not assign a resolved current/exit state to UPP without later evidence.
Do not treat project-level parcel ownership or customer permits as separate manager-level equity.
Do not store 2024-2025 as a precise platform entry year for Bauxite SPVs without deed evidence.
